task.purpose: Write docs/DEVOPS-HANDOVER.md (a new file, approved by Umesh): the single ordered runbook DevOps executes to take the Virtual Counsellor live on Ubuntu + systemd + nginx, so VC does not repeat the Knowledge Base go-live failures. You own docs/DEVOPS-HANDOVER.md; infra/ubuntu/README.md (add one pointer line at the top, and fix any step that conflicts with the facts below); qa/evidence/t057/network-2026-11-01.md (correct the request text's Pathlynks port to what config/sources.json and mcp/pathlynks/src/connect.ts actually use). acceptance: Read first, read-only: D:/KnowledgeBase/docs/DEVOPS-HANDOVER.md and D:/KnowledgeBase/docs/DEVOPS-REDEPLOY-2026-11-01.md. Copy their good structure: owner-ordered checklist, names-only env tables with who supplies each, pre-checks and backups, smoke checks with expected output, rollback, a Not-confirmed list. Put a short Why section listing the KB failures VC must not repeat: Mongo exposed with no password (security after go-live), compose not forwarding env, an outer proxy redirecting to a raw IP nobody owned, guessed values (TRUST_PROXY_HOPS), the runbook written after the failed deploy. Then read qa/evidence/deploy-readiness.md, infra/ubuntu/README.md, infra/ubuntu/vc-api.service, infra/ubuntu/nginx-vc.conf, docs/partner-integration.md (S13 release section), apps/api/src/main.ts, apps/api/src/index.ts (env reads, bind), apps/api/src/go-live-gate.ts.

Sections, in order: (1) What VC is: a Node 20.16+ TypeScript service, NOT Python, no Claude Code at runtime; M1 = anonymous chat behind TLS, M2 = embedded personalised chat after partner keys. (2) Owner-ordered checklist table (DevOps / Umesh / Pathlynks team / Vidysea team), network and security first. (3) Network allow-list table, host role and port only, no real hostnames or IPs: VC Mongo virtual_counsellor, the Pathlynks DB with the verified port, the Vidysea DB read-only TLS, the KB base URL, Gemini egress, Ollama or LiteLLM if used, api.github.com if admin sync is used; inbound 443 only via nginx. (4) Server env file /etc/vc/vc.env: names only, the M1 required set, M2 additions, optional; who supplies each value; values travel by a private channel. MUST set VC_GATE_APPROVER=Umesh (exact match with the qa/gates records) and VC_LLM_PROVIDER to gemini or litellm, never mock. PEM keys as one line with escaped newlines, or a JWKS URL. The systemd EnvironmentFile takes no export and no shell expansion. (5) Host steps, each with its expected result: git clone the repo, never copy folders (skills/, qa/gates/, qa/evidence/p1-a10-diag/ and config/ are read at boot); Node >=20.16; pnpm pinned by packageManager; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile on the server, never --prod, never copy node_modules from Windows. (6) Pre-start gate check: pnpm -C apps/api go-live-gate student-routes must print the allowed result (find the exact output wording in apps/api/scripts/go-live-gate.ts). (7) nginx: CORS is done by the API per partner key, so never add Access-Control headers at nginx or a CDN; only the listed /v1 locations are proxied; builder A is adding /health and /ready as exact locations. (8) Smoke checks with exact expected output: curl /health -> 200 {"status":"ok"}, /ready -> 200 {"status":"ready"}, one anonymous turn, the partner openapi. (9) Widget release dir /widget/releases/<sha>/ with its files and the sha256 command. (10) Rollback. (11) Not confirmed, ask Umesh: the Vidysea production frontend origin; the KB public base URL (vidysea.com/knowledgebase currently redirects to a raw IP); the student JWT issuer, keys and tenant ids; the RDS CA files. (12) Known gaps, later: Dockerfile/CI, /vc-popout not routed, no widget release script, no production Langfuse, single replica only (rate limits and caps are per process), the API binds 127.0.0.1 only. (13) What DevOps sends back: public URL, server egress IP, node and pnpm versions, git sha deployed, smoke-check output. (14) A short ready-to-send request message for DevOps.

Every env name you list must exist in code (grep it; report any you could not find). Every command and path must exist in the repo. Plain, short English sentences. No secrets, no real hostnames, IPs or passwords.

Commit once, staging only your owned files by path, with message 'docs: DevOps handover runbook for VC go-live' and footer 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. Report: commit sha, the files, the Pathlynks port you verified with file:line, and any env names you could not find in code.
checks: No product code edits, no server starts, no network calls.
